name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: AI Integration, Automation, and Digital Product Specialist with 8+ years of experience connecting marketing, operations, CRM, data, and web development. Built workflows using n8n, APIs/webhooks, practical Python, and Supabase/PostgreSQL, and extracted and cleansed web data for a database of nearly 200 establishments. Experienced in cross-channel measurement, lead operations, revenue metrics, and automated funnels. At Wipro on the Meta Project, led native CRM AI adoption, increasing usage by 150%, while conducting call listening, quality reviews, and structured coaching. At AK Branding, delivered 40+ web projects for SMBs and implemented chatbot workflows that increased lead capture by 250%. Combines practical technical execution, root-cause analysis, documentation, and remote collaboration to replace manual processes with reliable, measurable systems.
